> Palma Advanced Cursor Control (PACC) is a gesture-control glove that turns your hand into a mouse. An IMU tracks hand orientation for cursor movement, flex sensors on the fingers detect pinch and tap gestures for clicks, and it pairs as a Bluetooth HID mouse to any device with no drivers needed. Custom PCB built around the ESP32-S3 with LiPo power and haptic feedback.

## Design

### 2026-10-08 – # October 6th 2026

**7h**

# October 6th 2026

I started this project as something inspired from a lot of  sci-fi movies. My plan is to build something which can control any device using you palm without ever touching a mouse. It could entirely replace a mouse as a ring in the future, but this version is more like a glove based one.

What it does is that it connects to any device via bluetooth or USB C and can control the device like for example, how you would control everything in an Apple Vision Pro. I expect it to work with multiple devices at once, seamlessly, without needing to connect and disconnect (with all i know, an ESP23 can connect to 7 normal bluetooth devices at once).

What i have done right now is plan out the entire structure of it. How it will work, what all functions it would have and what all i should be concerned about.
